name: load_animation_frame_fields
description: Uses one byte of the caller's record as an index into three lookup tables, storing the looked-up frame values into the record's animation fields and clearing a flag byte.

name: advance_position_by_speed
description: Calls the frame-loading routine, stores its register result in the record, and when the record's counter is non-zero adds a speed field to the word at the second argument before stepping the counter by a stored increment.

name: decode_sequence_command_byte
description: Reads one command byte from a sequence stream: a zero byte stores the next two bytes as parameters, bytes above 111 are stored as a value, smaller bytes are stored as channel fields, and negative bytes set a wait count from their complement.

name: initialise_voice_and_write_entry
description: When the record's trigger field is set, it clears the record's counters, sets its state to 4, looks up an entry in the sequence table and a starting value in a second table, then writes a longword and two words into the output buffer.

name: update_voice_and_clamp_output
description: Calls seven unnamed update routines, adds the record's slide value to its pitch, keeps the pitch between about 95 and 5760, and writes the result into the output buffer at offset 6.

name: step_repeat_counter
description: While a table count is non-zero, it increments the record's counter until it reaches the table's limit, then adds the table count to the record's offset field.

name: dispatch_channel_effect_command
description: Decodes the low nibble of a command word and applies one effect when the record's flags allow it: a table-driven pitch, a slide negate or copy, a volume ramp up or down, a level write, an output volume, or a flag change.

name: slide_pitch_toward_target
description: Looks up a target pitch from a table using the record's command index, derives the signed step needed to reach it, and moves the current pitch toward the target by that step, stopping exactly on the target and returning the pitch.

name: set_pitch_from_command_table
description: Computes a table index from the command word and a byte in the caller's data, then loads the pitch value at that index into the record.

name: negate_slide_step
description: Stores the negated command word as the record's slide step so the pitch moves in the opposite direction.

name: copy_command_value_to_slide
description: Copies the command word unchanged into the record's slide step field.

name: step_secondary_envelope_pitch
description: Advances the secondary envelope counter: when it reaches the segment length it reloads from length minus step and adds a table value to the pitch, otherwise it increments the counter.

name: step_primary_envelope_pitch
description: Advances the primary envelope counter using its own record fields, reloading the counter and adding a lookup-table value to the pitch when the segment ends, otherwise incrementing the counter.

name: advance_sample_envelope_segment
description: Steps a sample envelope: when its counter reaches the limit it reloads the counter and, if the table rate byte is non-negative, writes a longword and word for the new sample into the output buffer; a negative rate just backs the counter off by one.

name: write_quarter_volume_to_output
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then writes the record's volume value divided by four into the output buffer at offset 8.

name: run_envelope_state_machine
description: Advances the record's level envelope one step according to its state: a ramp up, a ramp down, a counted pause, or a timed hold, moving to the next state when each one finishes.

name: write_chipset_control_registers
description: Writes the audio control, both CIA interrupt-control, copper control, DMA control and interrupt-enable registers. The decompiler gave no pseudo-code, so the exact values written are not recovered.

name: copy_boot_blocks_run_io
description: Copies a 20-word block and then eight blocks of 180 words into a fixed memory area, writes four copper-style list words for colour registers, calls the same library routine twice, and copies a 144-longword table; the decompiled body then ends in undecodable bytes.

name: copy_blocks_and_set_copper
description: Copies a 20-word block and eight blocks of 180 words into memory, sets the first copper list pointer, calls the exec DoIO routine twice, copies a 144-longword table, and ends in undecodable bytes that the decompiler could not translate.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data

name: toggle_interrupt_enable_mask
description: Writes an interrupt enable mask, calls one unnamed routine, then writes a second mask. The first value has bit 15 clear, so it disables the listed bits, and the second has it set, so it enables them. The listing also touches the interrupt request register.

name: set_interrupt_enable_and_call
description: Clears a stored value, then writes a saved value with bit 15 set into the interrupt enable register and calls one unnamed routine. The register note says bit 15 set enables the listed interrupts.

name: advance_audio_frame_counters
description: Increments two counters, clears a flag, and counts a third down from ten, inverting a fourth on each wrap. It then counts a countdown down, sets a global when it reaches zero, and calls one unnamed routine. The listing shows the channel 0 audio length register touched.

name: wait_flag_then_mask_byte
description: Loops while a shared flag is non-zero, then returns the input byte with bit 0 and bits 3 to 7 forced on.

name: restore_interrupt_enable_state
description: Writes two saved values to a global register, then writes a third saved value with bit 15 set, which enables the interrupts it selects. The listing shows the interrupt enable register touched.

name: update_joystick_position
description: Reads the joystick port movement and updates horizontal and vertical positions clamped to the screen range, then sets direction bits. It only acts in one mode and calls one unnamed routine in the other.

name: read_mouse_movement_and_buttons
description: Decodes the mouse port movement and button bits into per-axis deltas, clamps the horizontal and vertical positions to 0 to 319 and 0 to 199, and writes the press state into the output structure.

name: stub_infinite_loop
description: Contains only an infinite loop with no visible writes, and the decompiler removed the unreachable blocks around it; no further behaviour is recovered.

name: run_frame_loop_with_blitter
description: Opens and closes an exec library, builds a copper list of colour register entries, clears a block of memory, then loops on each vertical blank, reading characters from a table and updating blitter and copper registers for the next frame.

name: fill_three_word_tables
description: Fills three 100-entry tables of four words each with fixed start values and flag words. For each entry it calls an unnamed routine and adds its result to a running offset to form the next value.

name: next_pseudo_random_value
description: Advances a 32-bit state by doubling it, xoring in a fixed constant when the shift overflows or becomes zero, and returns that state modulo a range value. A non-positive range instead stores its negation as the state and returns the input unchanged.

name: build_sprite_pointer_list
description: Scans a table of entries for their maximum value, derives a base address from it and a counter, then writes a list of 15 pointers, each advanced by a stored step when its flag is not minus one.

name: reset_state_to_fifteen
description: Writes zero to a global four times, then sets it to 15. The listing lists two colour registers and the DMA control register as touched, but the decompiled body shows only the global writes.

name: write_audio_channel_registers
description: Advances four audio channel control blocks, writes each channel's pointer, length and period into the audio hardware registers, and on a three-frame countdown applies flagged changes through an unnamed routine.

name: set_audio_channels_from_pattern
description: Loops over four audio channels, looking up each channel's pattern entry from a table, computing its period and volume from the entry's fields, and storing the result in that channel's control block.

name: initialise_audio_channel_from_table
description: Clears a flag byte and copies a block of eight longwords from the channel's stored pointer. It then either sets up the channel's fields from a table, storing a new pointer with a scaled volume, or looks up a period entry and sets the pointer, negating the sample bytes when the block's flags say so.

name: store_channel_period_from_table
description: Looks up a 16-bit value in a period table using a byte index and stores it in a field of the channel block.

name: apply_active_channel_updates
description: Walks four audio channel blocks and calls an unnamed routine for each block whose active flag is set.

name: advance_channel_envelope_steps
description: For one audio channel, decrements three step timers when their flags are set. When a timer expires it reloads it from a table, computes a new volume or period from table values, and advances a step counter that clears the flag when reached; a further branch copies or negates bytes of a sample buffer.

name: stub_undecompiled_routine
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available. The listing records only that it has 11 instructions and is called by three unnamed routines, so its behaviour is not recovered.

name: run_frame_loop_with_blitter
description: Calls an unnamed library routine twice at a fixed library offset, builds a copper list of colour register entries, clears a block of memory, then loops on each vertical blank, reading characters from a table and updating blitter and copper registers for the next frame.

name: free_blocks_and_clear_field
description: Calls a helper routine, then runs three passes of a library call that frees memory, calling another helper on each pass, and finally clears a longword field of the caller's structure.

name: decrement_until_minus_one
description: Decrements a local counter until it reaches negative one and then returns.

name: allocate_block_and_run_command
description: Allocates a memory block and copies a 112-longword template into it, relocating its pointer entries by the block's base. Without arguments it runs the wait routine; otherwise it copies the command arguments into a buffer, then calls library routines to wait for and reply to messages.

name: release_resources_and_reply
description: Calls an optional cleanup hook if one is set, releases library resources and frees memory, then replies to a message through the library.

name: open_dos_library_or_release
description: Opens the DOS library by name and returns its address if that succeeds. Otherwise it runs the same release sequence as its sibling and returns 100.

name: run_dos_command_with_arguments
description: Looks up the current task, delays, opens an output file, copies argument strings into a buffer and runs the command through the DOS execute call. The NIL and RUN device names are referenced in the text.

name: check_string_is_number
description: Skips an optional leading minus sign, then returns 1 if every character up to the terminator is a decimal digit and 0 otherwise.
